channel.title: AI Tools & Models HOT
channel.description: Daily AI model releases and leading agent updates, scored by rules from 10 sources. Titles, one-line summaries and links only — no full text republished.

item.title: OpenAI’s GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol now available
item.description: GitHub Copilot now offers the new GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol from OpenAI, two models built for agentic coding and code review whose coding judgment beats earlier models.

item.title: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
item.description: The new Astra and Sol variants of GPT-6.2 deliver better professional output, coding, and computer use at lower cost, now live across the API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work.

This release is mostly experience polish: a confirmation step before installing the GitHub app, a /status listing for broken configuration files, a /config note when settings get overridden, and a way to feed MCP server JSON via stdin.

item.title: Put Gemini to work for you
item.description: The Gemini app adds free task features: hand it something to get done, and it works on it in the background for you.

item.title: GitHub Copilot Fusion updates: more availability, benchmarks, and models
item.description: Copilot Fusion gains new models, reaches more Copilot surfaces, and posts scores on two public Terminal-Bench leaderboards, making it easier to pick and compare.

item.title: GitHub Copilot app, Microsoft Ignite releases
item.description: The Copilot app now works with Azure DevOps repositories and GitHub Enterprise Server instances, and runs in the browser too, meeting users where they work.

item.title: GitHub Copilot in JetBrains, Ignite releases
item.description: Copilot for JetBrains now lets you work remotely, dictate by voice on-device, and set browser use controls, with shortcuts for context usage and a look back at historical diffs.

item.title: Monitor GitHub Copilot activity through Microsoft Agent 365
item.description: Enterprises can now pipe agent activity from every Copilot client straight into Microsoft Agent 365, so audit trails sit in one control plane.

item.title: GitHub Copilot Evals is now in public preview
item.description: Copilot Evals is in public preview: after prompts, models, skills, or tools change, it checks whether Copilot is still performing at its best.

item.title: More ways to move care forward with ChatGPT for Healthcare
item.description: The update adds computer-use agents, better clinical answers and new healthcare plugins so ChatGPT can do real work inside medical workflows.

item.title: What We've Learned Building Proactive Agents
item.description: LangChain reviews lessons from building GTM Agent and Robin: proactive agents push toward goals on their own and ask for input only when needed, with memory and interaction design deciding success.

item.title: Protect sensitive data in your traces: new controls in LangSmith
item.description: LangSmith has added new access controls that help teams manage sensitive information inside trace data, so each member only sees what their permissions allow.

item.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Sales
item.description: ChatGPT gains a sales-focused plugin plus more than 30 new and expanded partner plugins, helping sales teams research prospects, prepare pitches, keep CRM records up to date, and move deals forward.

item.title: Copilot code review: Adaptive effort, secret detection, and more
item.description: Copilot code review now adapts its depth to each pull request, giving routine changes a quick pass and digging deeper where it matters, plus detection for leaked secrets.

item.title: MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash in GitHub Copilot
item.description: Microsoft's new generation of AI coding models, MAI Code 2 and the lighter MAI Code 2 Flash, are now live in Copilot.

item.title: GitHub Copilot CLI adds Microsoft Entra sign-in as a preview
item.description: The Copilot CLI now offers Microsoft Entra sign-in in public preview, letting you authenticate silently with a Microsoft account linked to a managed enterprise user.

item.title: Track Copilot code review outcomes in Repository insights
item.description: A new Repository insights page shows how Copilot code review feedback actually lands across each repository.

item.title: Introducing Devin Bots: from tasks to outcomes
item.description: Devin Bots are engineering teammates that take ownership of a goal and lead a team of Devins to deliver it.

item.title: Broadening access to AI for scientists
item.description: OpenAI expanded its ChatGPT for Academic Researchers program, giving 200,000 researchers worldwide free access to its frontier models.

item.title: Science at the Frontier: How scientists use ChatGPT
item.description: OpenAI surveyed more than 1,800 scientists about their daily use, showing how AI is changing research workflows, productivity and expectations for discovery.
